metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1tb[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Fast inspect-first video artifacts in the tmux viewer pane[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Opening a video artifact from the Agents tab inside tmux shows a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]useful frame in about half a second (always under 1 s) over SSH. It[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never garbles pane titles or lags tmux or the SASE TUI. The user [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]can scrub frames, play motion where the topology supports it, or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]hand off to a native player. The fixed per-open launch tax is gone [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for every artifact kind.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]fast_video_artifact_pane.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/fast_video_artifact_pane.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1tb[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-1tb/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop launching mpv in tmux; show a still frame plus metadata[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tmux-still-hotfix[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tmux-still-hotfix: inside tmux with a kitty VO, render an ffmpeg still [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plus ffprobe metadata through kitten icat instead of mpv. Make missing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tools non-fatal, add ffmpeg/ffprobe doctor rows, fix the Video Preview [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, and ship the pty+tmux regression probe.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Trim the viewer child's startup tax[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]viewer-child-startup[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]viewer-child-startup: pass the parent's resolved video config to the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pane child through an env snapshot, lazy-import markdown_pdf, replace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the clear subprocess with ANSI, add the child-side trace helper, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]measure and fix kitten icat detection cost inside tmux.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Move tmux split and decoration off the Textual UI thread[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]async-pane-launch[dim] · [dim][/dim]after viewer-child-startup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]async-pane-launch: launch the tmux split and pane decoration in a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]pump-free worker with an explicit launch context and bounded tmux [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timeouts. Show an opening state, show a VCS-materialization progress [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]toast, and emit parent-side open spans correlated with the child.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Persistent frame, scrub-track, and storyboard cache[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]video-frame-cache[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tmux-still-hotfix[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]video-frame-cache: add the ffmpeg-backed frame service. It does [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exact-frame extraction, a low-priority background scrub track, a decile [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]storyboard composed with Pillow, and a content-digest-keyed bounded [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cache with atomic writes and cancellation.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Inspect-first video view with scrubbing keys[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]inspect-scrubber[dim] · [dim][/dim]after video-frame-cache, viewer-child-startup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inspect-scrubber: replace the video branch with an inspect view. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shows the frame, a storyboard strip, and a status line. Keys: h/l and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]arrows to step, ',' and '.' for single frames, 0-9 for deciles, s for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]storyboard, space to play. Add a nonblocking escape-aware key reader, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]step coalescing, stable kitty image ids, spans, docs, and a probe [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]extension.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Motion backends, native handoff, and audio semantics[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]motion-handoff[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inspect-scrubber[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]motion-handoff: add the backend and open_command config keys. mpv runs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-pane only where it can render, with sw-fast, a probed shm flag, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]--audio=no. The o key hands off to a native or configured player. Add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]degraded banners and a motion_start span, update docs and config [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reference, and record the deferred follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cell-preview fallback for terminals without kitty graphics[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]non-kitty-fallback[dim] · [dim][/dim]after motion-handoff[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]non-kitty-fallback: detect kitty-graphics capability from the terminal [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]name, using tmux's client_termname inside tmux. Otherwise render the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]current frame with the existing Unicode cell renderer plus metadata, and[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fall back the same way when kitten icat fails.[/#D7D7AF]
